nom: Vacation Super Spritz SPF50 Face Mist

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-leaning combination skin are divided: several say the mist feels greasy, migrates into eyes, and doesn't sit well under makeup, while one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports no clogged pores or breakouts at all.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including ones with very dry or eczema-prone skin, generally report no issues and say it adds moisture without feeling greasy or sticky.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: a couple with oily-leaning combination skin found it too greasy and hard to wear under matte makeup, while another describes it as ideal for combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report sharply different experiences: a number describe burning, stinging, itching, hives, breakouts or an allergic reaction including eyelid swelling on application, while several others with sensitive or reactive skin say they had zero irritation and recommend it; more than one reviewer suggests patch-testing first.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin says it added moisture without feeling greasy or sticky.
segments.mature: A 59-year-old reviewer says it keeps her skin hydrated, refreshed and de-puffed throughout long workdays.

concerns.redness: Several reviewers report their skin turned red, swollen or developed small red bumps after applying, with symptoms ranging from brief stinging to itching that lasted about a week; many other reviewers report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product damaged her skin barrier despite a clean patch test, while most other reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, describe no barrier-related issues.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are sharply divided: several reviewers describe sudden breakouts, hives or fungal acne after using this, including one who normally doesn't react to products, while multiple other reviewers, including ones with oily or acne-prone skin, say it caused no breakouts or clogged pores at all.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers are divided on finish: many describe the mist as greasy, oily-looking or prone to making makeup slip, sometimes needing blotting, while a comparable number, including some with oily skin, describe it as lightweight and non-greasy.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the mist as hydrating or moisturizing rather than drying, but a few connect the alcohol listed as the first ingredient to skin feeling dry, tight or irritated, particularly for reactive skin.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns if it gets in eyes

extraits.texte: I wanted to love it but I broke out and itched for a week on cheeks and neck.

I love the packaging and ease of having sunscreen that doesn't ruin makeup and can travel in a purse. The problem, however, is upon application this stuff burns the skin on my face. Yes, it only lasts for a few seconds, but it's an unpleasant few. If you don't have sensitive skin, this would probably work beautifully.

extraits.titre: I would never buy any product from this brand
extraits.texte: I had a negative reaction to this product it ruined my skin barrier. I even did a patch test which seemed to be fine. This says it has slight fragrance but it's very strong. I would not recommend this one to anyone. Be careful!

I used to be the girl who never wore sunscreen unless I was spending all day outside. I was also the girl who used tanning beds. Cringe. Now that I'm in my 30s and dealing with sun damage, I make sure to wear SPF daily. I was happy to have the opportunity to try Super Spritz SPF 50 Face Mist by Vacation. This is the first sunscreen I've tried from them, and so far I like it. The mist feels fine and disperses evenly. It does have a strong coconut/sunscreen scent that didn't bother me but might bother others. I didn't like that it made my face look greasy though. As someone with combo skin that leans oily, this is something I try to avoid. For that fact, I don't see myself wearing this over makeup since I prefer a matte finish. I will wear this on days that I don't wear make-up, though. My favorite part of this sunscreen is the mist. It makes application and reapplication a breeze. This will be perfect to take on the go. I also like that this is SPF 50, what I usually try to wear. I'm happy I had the chance to try this! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Now this is not my primary facial SPF. (I use Elta MD UV Clear Tinted with and without makeup). I carry this in my bag for reapplication. I have very dry, sensitive and ectopic skin and have no issues with this product. I love that it does not affect my makeup. Great for pool days, long days of softball tournaments or anytime I want to top off. My girls will even use it at games etc when they don't want to slather on more sunscreen. I know everyone is different, but I have no issues with the scent bothering my skin and this has never burned my eyes. Give it shot!

I have been waiting a long time for a product like this. It makes applying sunblock so easy and simple. I've been hearing it for years how important it is to use SPF. Especially in skin care. I haven't started doing that until this last couple of years though. Normally in my experience, products that have SPF in it make my skin feel oily or I get a white cast look going on. Sometimes it will be a whole separate product of its own and an extra step in my regimen that sometimes I feel like I don't have time for. This is literally perfect! It has a very light scent kind of like coconut maybe. It is soothing on my skin and the way the mist comes out is perfect. Not too much product, not too heavy, and really easy to use. It hasn't clogged my pores or caused my oily acne prone skin to get any acne at all! I cannot stress how important that is to me. It is also the perfect size. I usually have it right there in my purse so I can reach for it if you need to reapply. I assume it works because I haven't been sunburned being outside for long periods of time. I even use it on my kids! This is a game changer for sunscreen. You can't even tell you're wearing it! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I don't know why I have been buying facial sunscreen that I have to rub in, because after trying this Super Spritz SPF 50 Face mist, I am never going back. This is the perfect option when you don't have clean hands, are on the go, or when you are worried about pilling. I have always struggled with facial sunscreens that pills, especially when getting one with such a high SPF. With this spray, I don't have to worry about any pilling at all, which is by far my favorite part of the product. I absolutely love having a high SPF sunscreen as someone with fair dry skin that can sunburn easily if not properly taken care of. This sunscreen did an amazing job at keeping me from getting burned in the sun. This product also smells amazing and gives you a beautiful bright glow. I would describe the smell as a light Caribbean beach day scent that reminded me of a mix of sweet bananas, vanilla, and coconut. It smells incredible. The mist function also worked insanely well. It perfectly coated my face without leaving behind droplets. This could easily go on top of makeup without ruining it. The product felt very lightweight on my face and made my skin feel really soft. I normally have normal/dry skin type and this spray seemed to add moisture without being greasy or sticky. It also seemed to be fairly water-resistant, and stayed on my face for about an hour or two before it felt like it was starting to wear off.
